title: FDI Spillovers in History: Interwar Japanese “Zaikabo” investment in China’s cotton spinning industry
title_zh: 历史中的FDI溢出效应：两次世界大战期间日本在华“在华纺”投资与中国棉纺织业
title_primary: 历史中的FDI溢出效应：两次世界大战期间日本在华“在华纺”投资与中国棉纺织业
title_secondary: FDI Spillovers in History: Interwar Japanese “Zaikabo” investment in China’s cotton spinning industry
authors: Holger Görg, Toshihiro Okubo, Eric Strobl, Maximilian von Ehrlich
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We estimate productivity spillovers from Japanese cotton-spinning firms in China (known as Zaikabo) to local Chinese cotton-spinning mills based on plant-level data for 1925 to 1938. In order to capture the important role of distance in facilitating such spillovers we geo-localised the plants. Our results provide clear evidence for positive spillovers from Zaikabo to local Chinese mills, which go hand-in-hand with an upgrade in production technology towards greater use of capital. Spillovers are very localised, being strongest within a radius of up to 10 km around the Zaikabo and particularly strong for mills in Shanghai. Exploiting information on the workforce composition of the Japanese affiliates, we find suggestive evidence of a skilled-labour channel: spillovers tend to be larger from Zaikabo employing higher shares of skilled labour. We also find some evidence in line with the idea that these gains are larger for Chinese mills with higher initial productivity, consistent with a role for absorptive capacity. Our paper is the first to document FDI productivity spillovers in a historical context and to characterise the channels through which they operate.
abstract_zh: 我们基于1925年至1938年的工厂层面数据，估算了日本在华棉纺企业（即“在华纺”）对本地中国棉纺厂的生产率溢出效应。为捕捉距离在促进此类溢出中的重要作用，我们对工厂进行了地理定位。研究结果清晰表明，在华纺对本地中国棉纺厂存在正向溢出效应，且这些效应伴随着生产技术向资本更密集使用的升级。溢出效应具有高度本地化特征，在华纺周围10公里半径内最为显著，尤其在上海的棉纺厂中表现突出。利用日本附属企业劳动力构成的信息，我们发现了技能劳动力渠道的提示性证据：雇佣技能劳动力比例较高的在华纺，其溢出效应往往更大。我们还发现一些证据支持这些收益对中国初始生产率较高的棉纺厂更为显著，这与吸收能力的作用相符。本文首次在历史背景下记录了外商直接投资的生产率溢出效应，并刻画了其作用渠道。

title: Emotional and physical burdens of water poverty: evidence from the drinking water service ladder in Mozambique
title_zh: 水贫困的情感与身体负担：来自莫桑比克饮用水服务阶梯的证据
title_primary: 水贫困的情感与身体负担：来自莫桑比克饮用水服务阶梯的证据
title_secondary: Emotional and physical burdens of water poverty: evidence from the drinking water service ladder in Mozambique
authors: Terrence Kairiza, Wanglin Ma, Abbi Kedir
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-09-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Access to safe and reliable drinking water remains uneven across sub-Saharan Africa, yet existing evidence largely focuses on health outcomes and binary measures of access, overlooking how different service levels affect everyday well-being. This study examines how the water service ladder shapes the emotional and physical burdens of water poverty and whether these effects differ by household head gender in Mozambique. Using nationally representative data from the 2022–2023 Mozambique Demographic and Health Survey and a multivalued treatment effects framework, we estimate the impacts of unimproved, limited, basic, and safely managed water services on water-related worry, anger, hygiene deprivation, and insufficient drinking water. Results show that limited services, i.e., improved sources located more than 30 min away, do not significantly reduce water-related distress relative to unimproved sources. In contrast, both basic and safely managed services substantially reduce emotional and physical burdens, with no additional gains from on-premises access beyond the 30-minute accessibility threshold. Female-headed households are more likely to access improved services, but the well-being benefits of improved water access do not differ by household head gender. These findings highlight the importance of service proximity rather than source type alone and suggest that progress toward Sustainable Development Goal 6 may be overstated when measured using binary indicators of improved access. The results emphasize the need for policy strategies that prioritize reducing collection time to deliver meaningful well-being gains from water infrastructure investments.
abstract_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区安全可靠饮用水的获取仍不均衡，然而现有证据主要关注健康结果和二元化的获取指标，忽视了不同服务水平对日常福祉的影响。本研究考察了供水服务阶梯如何塑造水贫困的情感和身体负担，以及这些影响是否因莫桑比克户主性别而异。利用2022-2023年莫桑比克人口与健康调查的全国代表性数据以及多值处理效应框架，我们估算了未改善、有限、基本和安全管理的供水服务对与水相关的担忧、愤怒、卫生剥夺和饮用水不足的影响。结果显示，有限服务（即距离超过30分钟的改善水源）相对于未改善水源并未显著减少与水相关的困扰。相比之下，基本服务和安全管理的服务均大幅减少了情感和身体负担，而超过30分钟可达性阈值后，入户取水并未带来额外收益。女性户主家庭更可能获得改善服务，但改善供水获取的福祉收益并不因户主性别而异。这些发现强调了服务可达距离的重要性，而非仅关注水源类型本身，并表明当使用二元化的改善获取指标衡量时，可持续发展目标6的进展可能被高估。研究结果强调，政策策略需优先缩短取水时间，以从供水基础设施投资中实现有意义的福祉提升。

title: Farm labor scarcity and its uneven impacts on crop producers in the United States
title_zh: 美国农业劳动力短缺及其对农作物生产者不均衡的影响
title_primary: 美国农业劳动力短缺及其对农作物生产者不均衡的影响
title_secondary: Farm labor scarcity and its uneven impacts on crop producers in the United States
authors: Srabashi Ray, Alexandra E. Hill, Iman Haqiqi, J. Edward Taylor, Thomas W. Hertel
official: 官方在线 2026-09-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study is the first to evaluate the impacts of farm labor scarcity on producers in the United States across different crop production systems. Between 2002 and 2017, we disentangle the effects of labor scarcity from the impacts of rising commodity demand, technological change, and supply of other inputs on labor market outcomes. We leverage insights from a stylized theoretical framework, that shows labor market outcomes depend on these market forces and structural parameters like factor‐specific productivity changes, factor supply and substitutability. We implement a two‐step novel empirical strategy. First, we use constrained optimization approach to simultaneously estimate changes in input‐biased factor productivity, labor substitutability and price elasticity of labor supply for key Farm Resource Regions. Our estimates show that labor productivity in the Fruitful Rim region has stagnated relative to field crop dominant systems during our study period. This underscores the differences in capacity to adjust to labor shortages across production systems. Second, we use the first‐step estimates and a spatially explicit partial equilibrium model, to identify the responsiveness of wages and employment to reduced supply of farm workers. We find that a 1% annual decline in farm labor supply can increase hiring costs by 7.4% for specialty crop growers and 5.9% for field crop producers over the course of a decade. These can be further aggravated if trade policies increase demand from domestic producers and immigration policy further accentuate farm worker shortages. Addressing labor scarcity will be key to ensuring the long‐term sustainability and resilience of the agricultural sector.
abstract_zh: 本研究首次评估了美国不同作物生产体系中农业劳动力短缺对生产者的影响。在2002年至2017年间，我们将劳动力短缺的影响与大宗商品需求上升、技术进步及其他投入品供给对劳动力市场结果的作用区分开来。我们借助一个风格化理论框架的洞见，该框架表明劳动力市场结果取决于这些市场力量及结构性参数，如要素特定生产率变化、要素供给和替代性。我们实施了一种新颖的两步实证策略。首先，采用约束优化方法，同时估计关键农业资源区域中投入偏向型要素生产率变化、劳动力替代性及劳动力供给价格弹性。我们的估计显示，在研究期间，丰饶边缘地区的劳动生产率相对于以大田作物为主的系统停滞不前。这凸显了不同生产系统在适应劳动力短缺能力上的差异。其次，我们利用第一步估计结果及一个空间显式局部均衡模型，识别工资和就业对农业工人供给减少的响应。我们发现，农业劳动力供给每年下降1%，十年内可使特色作物种植者的雇佣成本增加7.4%，大田作物生产者增加5.9%。若贸易政策增加国内生产者需求，且移民政策进一步加剧农业工人短缺，这些影响可能进一步恶化。解决劳动力短缺问题将是确保农业部门长期可持续性和韧性的关键。

title: Democratizing Private Markets: Equilibrium Predictions
title_zh: 私有市场民主化：均衡预测
title_primary: 私有市场民主化：均衡预测
title_secondary: Democratizing Private Markets: Equilibrium Predictions
authors: Lubos Pastor, Robert F. Stambaugh, Lucian A. Taylor
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how opening private markets to retail investors affects investors and firms. Calibrating a production-based asset-pricing model, we find that democratization raises retail investors' welfare, but barely. Retail investors benefit little from democratization even if they face no extra cost or other disadvantage relative to institutional investors. The private market is simply too small for improved risk sharing to matter much. Whether or not private-market retail investing is costly, democratization substantially reshapes private firms' ownership and materially reduces their cost of capital, leading them to grow. Private equity earns a positive CAPM alpha, which shrinks after democratization.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了向散户投资者开放私募市场对投资者和企业的影响。通过校准一个基于生产的资产定价模型，我们发现民主化提升了散户投资者的福利，但效果甚微。即便散户投资者相对于机构投资者不承担额外成本或其他劣势，他们从民主化中获得的收益依然有限。私募市场规模过小，以至于改善风险分担所带来的影响微不足道。无论散户投资私募市场是否有成本，民主化都显著重塑了私营企业的所有权结构，并实质性降低了其资本成本，从而促进其增长。私募股权获得正的CAPM阿尔法，该值在民主化后有所缩减。

title: Averting Mortality, Enabling Mobility: Health and Economic Impacts of HIV Treatment at Scale
title_zh: 规避死亡，促进流动：大规模艾滋病治疗的健康与经济影响
title_primary: 规避死亡，促进流动：大规模艾滋病治疗的健康与经济影响
title_secondary: Averting Mortality, Enabling Mobility: Health and Economic Impacts of HIV Treatment at Scale
authors: Huan Wang, Victoria Baranov, Sarah Dickerson, Jeremy Barofsky
official: 官方在线 2026-05-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Antiretroviral therapy (ART) for HIV/AIDS has expanded rapidly across low-income countries since 2000, generating large gains in life expectancy. Exploiting spatial and temporal variation in ART availability, this paper examines the health and economic consequences of ART introduction across a comprehensive set of outcomes in rural Malawi, a low-income setting with high HIV prevalence. We find that ART substantially reduces prime-age mortality. Although these health gains raise individual prime-age labor supply, total household labor supply and household earnings are unchanged. We show that this divergence reflects the outward migration of prime-age household members, particularly men. Consistent with this mechanism, households receive sizable increases in remittances. Our findings identify migration as an important, but previously overlooked channel through which health shapes household economic outcomes.
abstract_zh: 自2000年以来，抗逆转录病毒疗法（ART）在低收入国家迅速推广，显著延长了预期寿命。利用ART可及性的时空差异，本文考察了在HIV高流行的低收入环境——马拉维农村地区，ART引入对一系列综合结果指标的健康与经济影响。我们发现，ART显著降低了壮年人口死亡率。尽管这些健康收益提高了个人壮年劳动力供给，但家庭总劳动力供给及家庭收入并未发生变化。我们证明，这一差异反映了壮年家庭成员，尤其是男性的向外迁移。与此机制相符，家庭收到的汇款显著增加。我们的研究结果揭示了迁移作为健康影响家庭经济结果的一个重要但此前被忽视的渠道。

title: Populism and academic freedom
title_zh: 民粹主义与学术自由
title_primary: 民粹主义与学术自由
title_secondary: Populism and academic freedom
authors: Silva, Rui
official: 官方在线 2026-08-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Academic freedom empowers scholars to influence public discourse and debate, cultivate critical reasoning, discuss ideas that challenge traditional values, and impose a soft check and balance on governments. For those reasons, governments have specific preferences regarding the extent of academic freedom, especially when led by populists, whose ideology, values, and strategic features are frequently at odds with the implications of this freedom. Using a quasi-experimental design, we confirm that academic freedom declines significantly under populist governments, a pattern largely independent of their host ideology. Those negative consequences increase after multiple populist terms, and extend more broadly to the substance of speech and the flow of information. Altogether, these results highlight the incompatibility of populism with democratic guarantees.
abstract_zh: 学术自由赋予学者影响公共话语与辩论、培养批判性思维、探讨挑战传统价值观的思想，并对政府施加一种软性的制衡机制。正因如此，各国政府，尤其是民粹主义领导下的政府，对学术自由的程度持有特定偏好，因为民粹主义的意识形态、价值观及策略特征往往与此自由的意涵相悖。通过准实验设计，我们证实民粹政府治下学术自由显著下降，且这一模式在很大程度上不受其所属意识形态的影响。这些负面效应在民粹执政多届后加剧，并更广泛地波及言论实质与信息流通。总体而言，这些结果凸显了民粹主义与民主保障之间的不相容性。

title: Corporate asset-backed securitization and firm performance in China: A shadow-leverage perspective
title_zh: 中国企业资产证券化与企业绩效：基于影子杠杆视角的研究
title_primary: 中国企业资产证券化与企业绩效：基于影子杠杆视角的研究
title_secondary: Corporate asset-backed securitization and firm performance in China: A shadow-leverage perspective
authors: Ronghui Pang, Yanan Zhang, Jianbiao Li, Shaopeng Xie
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Despite widespread optimism among regulators and market practitioners about corporate asset-backed securitization (ABS), its relationship with firm performance remains unclear. This study examines the association between corporate ABS and firm performance in China using a novel look-through approach to identify actual originators of ABS transactions. We document an inverted U-shaped relationship between corporate ABS scale and firm performance. Firm performance is positively associated with ABS issuance at low-to-moderate levels, but this association turns negative when issuance becomes excessive. Heterogeneity analyses show that this nonlinear relationship varies across ownership types and firm sizes and is more pronounced among non-state-owned and larger firms. Multiple analyses suggest that corporate ABS issuance in China functions less as pure risk transfer and more as debt-like financing, and the leverage-channel analysis further provides corroborative evidence that leverage helps explain the inverted U-shaped relationship between ABS issuance and firm performance. These findings advance our understanding of the relationship between corporate ABS and firm performance in China and offer practical implications for firms and regulators.
abstract_zh: 尽管监管机构和市场从业者普遍对企业资产支持证券化（ABS）持乐观态度，但其与企业绩效之间的关系仍不明确。本研究采用一种新颖的透视方法识别ABS交易的实际发起人，考察了中国企业ABS与企业绩效之间的关联。我们发现，企业ABS规模与企业绩效之间存在倒U型关系。在低至中等发行水平下，企业绩效与ABS发行正相关，但当发行过度时，这种关联转为负向。异质性分析显示，这种非线性关系因所有权类型和企业规模的不同而有所差异，且在非国有企业和大型企业中更为显著。多项分析表明，中国企业ABS发行更多扮演的是类似债务融资的角色，而非纯粹的风险转移，杠杆渠道分析进一步提供了佐证证据，表明杠杆有助于解释ABS发行与企业绩效之间的倒U型关系。这些发现加深了我们对中国企业ABS与企业绩效关系的理解，并为企业和监管机构提供了实践启示。

title: Exploring the determinants and recursive influences of land degradation and climate change adaptation technologies in Ethiopia: Evidence from a recursive multivariate probit model
title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚土地退化与气候变化适应技术的决定因素及递归影响探究：来自递归多元概率模型的证据
title_primary: 埃塞俄比亚土地退化与气候变化适应技术的决定因素及递归影响探究：来自递归多元概率模型的证据
title_secondary: Exploring the determinants and recursive influences of land degradation and climate change adaptation technologies in Ethiopia: Evidence from a recursive multivariate probit model
authors: Atalel Wubalem, Jan Cools, Zerihun Nigussie, Charlotte Fabri, Amare Sewnet Minale 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Land degradation and climate change remain pressing challenges to agricultural development in Ethiopia, where rural farm households rely heavily on rainfed agriculture amid mounting ecological stress and climate risks. Although Sustainable Land Management (SLM) practices are central to mitigating these risks, intervention outcomes are mixed, and most empirical studies rarely consider the recursive and endogenous nature of farmers’ adaptation decisions, failing to distinguish between independent and conditionally interdependent adaptation decisions, leaving a missing link in our understanding of their combined effects. While the standard multivariate probit model accounts for interdependence through correlated error terms, it still overlooks the structural and directional connections among SLM adaptation choices. Recursive specifications explicitly capture how upstream adaptation conditioned the feasibility and effectiveness of downstream adaptation, incorporating both correlation and causal ordering across SLM domains. Using this framework, the study investigates the determinants and interdependencies among structural, agronomic, and ecosystem-based SLM adaptation strategies, employing nationally representative data and a recursive multivariate probit (RMVP) model. Using 15,839 pooled observations from two waves of the Ethiopian Living Standards Measurement Survey (2018/19 and 2021/22), we modeled the recursive relationships among the three adaptation domains. Results demonstrate that the uptake of structural and agronomic measures significantly enhances ecosystem-based adaptation. In contrast, agronomic adaptation is positively influenced by structural adaptation, revealing strong complementarities among SLM technologies. Other exogenous covariates, such as education level, annual expenditure, food security, landholding, and participation in watershed programs, significantly increase the likelihood of adaptation, whereas market distance and plot remoteness constrain adaptation decisions. Viewing decision-making as a recursive process offers a more realistic depiction of how smallholders integrate multiple adaptation pathways amid complex socioeconomic and ecological constraints. Policies that promote integrated SLM practices are more likely to yield resilient, sustainable, and climate-smart land-use outcomes in Ethiopia.
abstract_zh: 土地退化与气候变化仍是埃塞俄比亚农业发展面临的紧迫挑战，该国农村农户在生态压力与气候风险日益加剧的背景下，高度依赖雨养农业。尽管可持续土地管理（SLM）实践是缓解这些风险的核心手段，但干预效果参差不齐，且多数实证研究很少考虑农户适应决策的递归性与内生性特征，未能区分独立适应决策与条件性相互依赖的适应决策，导致对其综合效应的理解存在缺失环节。标准多元概率比模型虽通过误差项相关性考虑了相互依赖关系，但仍忽视了SLM适应选择之间的结构性与方向性联系。递归设定明确刻画了上游适应如何制约下游适应的可行性与有效性，将SLM各领域间的相关性与因果顺序同时纳入分析。基于这一框架，本研究利用具有全国代表性的数据，采用递归多元概率比（RMVP）模型，考察结构性、农艺性和基于生态系统的SLM适应策略的决定因素及其相互依赖关系。利用埃塞俄比亚生活水平测量调查两轮数据（2018/19和2021/22年度）汇总的15，839个观测值，本研究对三类适应领域之间的递归关系进行了建模。结果表明，结构性措施和农艺措施的采纳显著促进了基于生态系统的适应；而农艺适应受到结构性适应的正向影响，揭示了SLM技术之间存在较强的互补性。其他外生协变量，如教育水平、年支出、粮食安全、土地持有量及参与流域治理项目，均显著提高适应概率，而市场距离和地块偏远程度则制约适应决策。将决策过程视为递归过程，能够更真实地刻画小农户在复杂社会经济与生态约束下如何整合多种适应路径。促进SLM综合实践的政策更有可能在埃塞俄比亚实现具有韧性、可持续和气候智慧型的土地利用结果。

title: Identity as Self-Image
title_zh: 身份作为自我形象
title_primary: 身份作为自我形象
title_secondary: Identity as Self-Image
authors: Roland Bénabou, Luca Henkel
official: 官方在线 2025-09-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We review the economic literature on self-image, which conceptualizes identity as a set of beliefs about one’s core traits, values, goals, and social ties. Self-image concerns lead individuals to process information and make choices in non-standard ways that help affirm and protect certain valued identities. We first present the main cognitive mechanisms involved within a simple unifying framework. We then survey the extensive laboratory, online, and field experimental literature on the nature and behavioral implications of self-image concerns. We discuss in particular how they give rise to information and decision avoidance, motivated memory and beliefs, excuse-driven behavior, preferences for truth-telling, hypothetical bias, moral cleansing and moral licensing, collective identities, political preferences, and other forms of self-signaling or self-deception. We subsequently discuss common empirical strategies used to identify self-image concerns, as well as the threats to their validity and how to alleviate them. We conclude by outlining open questions and directions for future research on the belief-based approach to identity.
abstract_zh: 我们回顾了关于自我形象的经济学文献，该文献将身份概念化为一组关于个人核心特质、价值观、目标和社会联系的信念。自我形象关切促使个体以非标准方式处理信息和做出选择，这些方式有助于肯定和保护某些被珍视的身份。我们首先在一个简单的统一框架内呈现涉及的主要认知机制。随后，我们综述了关于自我形象关切的本质及其行为含义的广泛实验室、在线和实地实验文献。我们特别讨论了这些关切如何导致信息和决策回避、动机性记忆和信念、借口驱动行为、偏好于说真话、假设偏差、道德净化与道德许可、集体身份、政治偏好以及其他形式的自我信号或自我欺骗。接着，我们讨论了用于识别自我形象关切的常见实证策略，以及这些策略有效性的威胁及如何缓解这些威胁。最后，我们概述了基于信念的身份研究方法中尚未解决的问题和未来研究的方向。

title: Social expectations and norm nudging in anti-coordination problems: An El Farol Bar Game experiment
title_zh: 反协调问题中的社会期望与规范助推：一个El Farol酒吧博弈实验
title_primary: 反协调问题中的社会期望与规范助推：一个El Farol酒吧博弈实验
title_secondary: Social expectations and norm nudging in anti-coordination problems: An El Farol Bar Game experiment
authors: Pietro Guarnieri, Lorenzo Spadoni
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Norm nudging interventions seek to influence behavior by shaping what individuals expect others to do ( empirical expectations ) or regard as appropriate ( normative expectations ). We study how such interventions operate in an anonymous anti-coordination problem, using an online El Farol Bar Game experiment composed of two studies. Study 1 elicits social expectations (empirical and normative) and personal normative beliefs before subjects make their decision in the El Farol Bar Game. Study 2 implements norm nudges by providing participants with pre-decision messages based on the social expectations elicited in Study 1. Results show that subjects conform not only to their empirical expectations, but also to their personal normative beliefs. Normative expectations exert weaker and less consistent effects. Moreover, norm nudging interventions primarily induce prudence by reducing behavior that jeopardizes social welfare.
abstract_zh: 规范助推干预旨在通过塑造个体对他人行为（经验预期）或社会认可行为（规范预期）的认知来影响其行为。我们通过一项由两项研究组成的在线“艾尔法罗尔酒吧博弈”实验，探讨此类干预在匿名反协调问题中的作用。研究一在受试者于艾尔法罗尔酒吧博弈中做出决策前，引出其社会预期（经验性与规范性）及个人规范信念。研究二则基于研究一中引出的社会预期，向参与者提供决策前信息，实施规范助推。结果表明，受试者不仅遵循其经验预期，还遵循其个人规范信念。规范性预期的影响较弱且不一致。此外，规范助推干预主要通过减少损害社会福利的行为来诱导谨慎行事。

title: A Nascent International Financial Channel of China's Monetary Policy Transmission
title_zh: 中国货币政策传导的新兴国际金融渠道
title_primary: 中国货币政策传导的新兴国际金融渠道
title_secondary: A Nascent International Financial Channel of China's Monetary Policy Transmission
authors: Zhou, Sili, Ma, Chang, Rebucci, Alessandro
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Chinese private portfolio equity outflows, though small compared to other Chinese outflows, are growing rapidly because of capital account liberalization and capital flight. Using granular stock-holding data on Qualified Domestic Institutional Investor (QDII) mutual funds, we identify a nascent financial channel of international transmission of Chinese monetary policy to world stocks. Event study analysis around monetary policy announcement days reveals that monetary policy tightening depresses returns of country equity indexes and individual U.S. stocks with QDII fund exposure relative to non-exposed stocks. The results are robust to controlling for the real transmission channel of Chinese monetary policy and other confounders. The effect is driven by smaller and less liquid firms, but not by China-concept stocks or those highly exposed to China
abstract_zh: 中国私人投资组合的股权流出规模虽不及其他类型的中国资本流出，但受资本账户自由化和资本外逃推动，正呈现快速增长态势。基于合格境内机构投资者（QDII）共同基金的股票持仓微观数据，我们识别出中国货币政策向全球股市传导的新兴金融渠道。围绕货币政策公告日的事件研究分析表明，相较于未受QDII基金持仓的股票，货币政策紧缩会压低受QDII基金持仓的国家股指及美国个股的收益率。在控制中国货币政策实际传导渠道及其他混杂因素后，该结论依然稳健。这一效应主要由规模较小、流动性较差的股票驱动，而非中国概念股或与中国高度关联的股票。

title: Who Profits from Amateurism? Rent-Sharing in Modern College Sports
title_zh: 谁从业余主义中获利？现代大学体育中的租金分享
title_primary: 谁从业余主义中获利？现代大学体育中的租金分享
title_secondary: Who Profits from Amateurism? Rent-Sharing in Modern College Sports
authors: Garthwaite, Craig, Holz, Nicole, Keener, Jordan, Notowidigdo, Matthew
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Intercollegiate amateur athletics in the US have historically prevented student-athletes from receiving market wages, creating substantial economic rents that are primarily generated by men’s football and basketball programs. Using financial data from college athletic departments, we estimate rent-sharing elasticities to measure how rents flow to women’s sports and other men’s sports and lead to increased spending on athletic facilities and coaches’ salaries. Using player-level data, we find that the rent-sharing transfers spending away from students who are more likely to be Black and come from poor neighborhoods towards students more likely to be White and come from higher-income neighborhoods.
abstract_zh: 美国高校业余体育历来禁止学生运动员获得市场工资，由此产生了主要由男子橄榄球和篮球项目创造的大量经济租金。利用高校体育部门的财务数据，我们估算了租金分享弹性，以衡量租金如何流向女子体育及其他男子体育项目，并导致体育设施和教练薪资支出增加。基于运动员个体数据，我们发现租金分享将支出从更可能是黑人和来自贫困社区的学生，转移至更可能是白人和来自高收入社区的学生。

title: Long-Run Intergenerational Effects of Social Security
title_zh: 社会保障的长期代际效应
title_primary: 社会保障的长期代际效应
title_secondary: Long-Run Intergenerational Effects of Social Security
authors: Daniel K. Fetter, Lee M. Lockwood, Paul Mohnen
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Both historically and today, support of aging parents has largely taken the form of in-kind transfers that require physical proximity, such as housing and caregiving. If Social Security substitutes for such support, it can relax constraints on where recipients' children live and work. We investigate the long-run intergenerational effects of the early Social Security program, exploiting within-occupation, cross-industry differences in coverage and a new dataset linking parents to their children's later-life outcomes. We find that sons whose parents had greater predicted coverage moved farther from their childhood homes, earned more, and lived in better neighborhoods late in life. We find no such effects for daughters, who tended to provide forms of support less easily replaced by Social Security. The gains considerably exceeded the associated Social Security benefits for the average family, with migration to better-matched labor markets a likely key driver. We propose that the early program enabled families to realize gains from migration that were back-loaded, uncertain, and difficult to contract on.
abstract_zh: 无论历史上还是当今，赡养年迈父母主要采取需要物理邻近性的实物转移形式，例如提供住房和照料。若社会保障制度替代了此类支持，则可缓解对受赡养者子女居住地和工作地点的约束。我们利用早期社会保障计划在职业内部、行业之间的覆盖差异，并结合将父母与其子女晚年生活状况相关联的新数据集，研究了该计划的长期代际效应。研究发现，父母预期保障覆盖率较高的家庭中，儿子成年后远离童年居住地、收入更高且晚年居住社区条件更优。但此类效应对女儿并不显著——女儿往往提供更难以被社会保障替代的支持形式。对普通家庭而言，这些收益远超其获得的社会保障福利，而迁移至更匹配的劳动力市场很可能是关键驱动因素。我们认为，早期计划使家庭能够实现迁移带来的滞后性、不确定且难以契约化的收益。

title: Securing Power, Compromising Climate: Evidence from Drought Shocks in China
title_zh: 保障电力，妥协气候：来自中国干旱冲击的证据
title_primary: 保障电力，妥协气候：来自中国干旱冲击的证据
title_secondary: Securing Power, Compromising Climate: Evidence from Drought Shocks in China
authors: Jing Cao, Rong Ma, Yu Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines how natural disasters complicate government efforts to balance energy security with the energy transition in regulated electricity systems. Using random variations in runoff as a natural experiment, we find that droughts lead to a long-term expansion of coal-fired power capacity. This expansion is reflected in extensive-margin adjustments, particularly through the commissioning of new coal-fired power plants. We also show that, under administrative regulation of electricity trading and generation, this investment response is driven primarily by government efforts to strengthen power supply stability rather than by firms’ profit-seeking incentives alone. Our findings highlight how adaptive responses to climate-related supply shocks can generate long-lasting fossil-fuel legacies in developing countries where electricity markets are not yet fully developed.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了在受监管的电力系统中，自然灾害如何使政府在平衡能源安全与能源转型之间的努力复杂化。利用径流量的随机变化作为自然实验，我们发现干旱导致燃煤发电能力的长期扩张。这种扩张体现在集约边际调整上，尤其是通过新建燃煤电厂来实现。我们还表明，在电力交易和发电受到行政监管的情况下，这一投资反应主要源于政府加强电力供应稳定性的努力，而非仅由企业逐利动机驱动。我们的研究结果凸显了，在电力市场尚未完全成熟的发展中国家，对气候相关供应冲击的适应性反应可能产生持久的化石燃料遗留效应。

title: Subsidies for reshoring: evidence from Taiwan
title_zh: 回流补贴：来自台湾的证据
title_primary: 回流补贴：来自台湾的证据
title_secondary: Subsidies for reshoring: evidence from Taiwan
authors: Kuo‐I Chang, Kazunobu Hayakawa
official: 官方在线 2026-07-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper empirically investigates the causal effect of subsidies on reshoring in Taiwan. The Taiwanese government has provided subsidies to Taiwanese firms to encourage them to relocate their factories from China back to Taiwan. Using the matched data between firm-level business information and the list of subsidy recipients from 2016 to 2023, we investigate how subsidy recipients change their behavior in both China and Taiwan. To mitigate the bias introduced by the selection mechanism in this subsidy, we employ the doubly robust difference-in-differences method. As a result, we found that this subsidy program has not induced reshoring or relocation of export base from China to Taiwan. Although some recipients expanded their production facilities and increased domestic sales, these changes were not significant enough to increase production and employment in Taiwan. These findings suggest that financial incentives alone are insufficient to offset the structural advantages of established production networks in China.
abstract_zh: 本文实证研究了补贴对台湾地区企业回迁的因果效应。台湾当局向本地企业提供补贴，鼓励其将工厂从中国大陆迁回台湾。通过匹配2016至2023年间企业层面商业信息与补贴接收方名单的数据，我们考察了补贴接收方在中国大陆和台湾地区的行为变化。为缓解该补贴选择机制带来的偏误，我们采用双重稳健双重差分法。结果表明，该补贴计划并未促使企业从中国大陆向台湾回迁或转移出口基地。尽管部分受补贴企业扩大了生产设施并增加了内销，但这些变化尚不足以显著提升台湾地区的生产与就业。这些发现表明，仅凭财政激励不足以抵消中国大陆成熟生产网络的结构性优势。

title: What Causes Geographic Variation in Drug Prescribing? Evidence from Physician Migration
title_zh: 医生迁移视角下药品处方地理差异的成因分析
title_primary: 医生迁移视角下药品处方地理差异的成因分析
title_secondary: What Causes Geographic Variation in Drug Prescribing? Evidence from Physician Migration
authors: David Beheshti, Seth Neller
official: 官方在线 2026-06-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this article, we examine the importance of individual physicians in explaining the significant variation in prescription drug spending in Medicare Part D. By tracking prescribing behavior before and after physician relocations, we find that movers' prescribing converges toward the average of their new location. However, this convergence is far from complete, highlighting the importance of idiosyncratic physician‐specific factors. Overall, these physician‐specific factors explain about 60 to 70 percent of the cross‐sectional variation in prescription drug spending, suggesting that physicians are one of the most important supply‐side determinants of this variation. We investigate several potential mechanisms behind this partial convergence.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在医疗保险D部分处方药支出显著差异中，个体医生的重要性。通过追踪医生迁移前后的处方行为，我们发现迁移者的处方模式会逐渐趋近于新地区的平均水平。然而，这种趋同远未完全实现，凸显了医生个体特有因素的关键作用。总体而言，这些医生特有因素解释了处方药支出横截面差异的60%至70%，表明医生是导致这种差异的最重要供给侧决定因素之一。我们进一步研究了这种部分趋同背后的若干潜在机制。

title: Social distance and delegation: Does anonymity matter?
title_zh: 社会距离与委托：匿名性是否重要？
title_primary: 社会距离与委托：匿名性是否重要？
title_secondary: Social distance and delegation: Does anonymity matter?
authors: Michalis Drouvelis, Hamideh Mohtashami Borzadaran
official: 官方在线 2026-04-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, we report on two experimental studies that examine the impact of social distance on delegation and uncover the role of anonymity driving delegation in a principal-agent setting. Study 1 shows that reducing the social distance makes principals less likely to delegate. Study 2 offers evidence that the likelihood of delegation is not affected by whether the principal is informed that the recipients will not find out whether the principal is their friend or a stranger. Our findings have implications for the underlying sources of pro-sociality in organizational settings where managers make their decisions through hiring external agents.
abstract_zh: 本文报告了两项实验研究，探讨社会距离对委托的影响，并揭示了匿名性在委托-代理情境中驱动委托行为的作用。研究一表明，缩短社会距离会降低委托人进行委托的可能性。研究二提供证据显示，委托人是否被告知接收者不会知晓其身份（朋友或陌生人）并不影响委托的可能性。我们的发现对组织环境中管理者通过雇佣外部代理人做出决策时亲社会行为的潜在来源具有启示意义。

title: Unleveling the playing field? — Experimental evidence on parents’ willingness to give their children an advantage
title_zh: 拉平竞技场？——父母给予子女优势意愿的实验证据
title_primary: 拉平竞技场？——父母给予子女优势意愿的实验证据
title_secondary: Unleveling the playing field? — Experimental evidence on parents’ willingness to give their children an advantage
authors: Oda Kristine Storstad Sund
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Parents play a pivotal role in shaping opportunities and outcomes for their children. This paper provides unique evidence on parents’ willingness to give their children an advantage. I report from a large-scale lab-in-the-field experiment involving 895 pairs of parents and their adolescent children, which is linked to high quality administrative data. In a situation with equal opportunities, parents are given the opportunity to increase the likelihood of their child winning in a competition. I find that a substantial share of parents prioritizes their own child’s success at the expense of another child’s opportunity to succeed. A considerable share of parents help their child because they expect another to do the same, in which case helping ensures a level playing field. However, I also find evidence suggestive of parents holding self-serving beliefs about the helping decision of other parents. Finally, I provide evidence of the helping decision in the experimental situation being associated with children with below median grades in mathematics doing particularly well at school in situations where parents can directly influence their grade. Taken together, the paper provides the first set of systematic evidence on parents’ willingness to give their own children an advantage, and the findings provide new insights on the role of parents in human capital accumulation.
abstract_zh: 父母在塑造子女的机会与成就方面扮演着关键角色。本文提供了关于父母愿意给予子女优势的独特证据。我报告了一项涉及895对父母及其青少年子女的大规模实地实验室实验结果，该实验与高质量的行政数据相关联。在机会均等的情境下，父母有机会增加其子女在竞争中获胜的可能性。我发现，相当一部分父母优先考虑自己子女的成功，而牺牲其他孩子成功的机会。相当多的父母帮助自己的孩子，是因为他们预期他人也会这样做，在这种情况下，帮助确保了公平的竞争环境。然而，我也发现了暗示父母对其他父母帮助决策持有自利信念的证据。最后，我提供的证据表明，在实验情境中的帮助决策与数学成绩低于中位数的儿童在父母能直接影响其成绩的情况下，在学校表现尤为出色相关联。总体而言，本文提供了关于父母愿意给予自己子女优势的首套系统性证据，这些发现为理解父母在人力资本积累中的作用提供了新的见解。

title: From Interaction to Business Fluctuations: How Credit Network Explains Cycles
title_zh: 从互动到经济波动：信贷网络如何解释周期
title_primary: 从互动到经济波动：信贷网络如何解释周期
title_secondary: From Interaction to Business Fluctuations: How Credit Network Explains Cycles
authors: EMANUELE CIOLA, GABRIELE TEDESCHI
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-01-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate the dynamic properties of capital flows in the U.S. economy by developing and estimating a heterogeneous agents macro‐economic model in which credit, deposits, and interbank relations evolve endogenously through optimal decentralized choices under limited information. Our findings suggest that severe financial crises stem from the endogenous formation of a highly centralized financial sector. In this setting, a self‐reinforcing bank run against systemic intermediaries, although rare, can freeze the interbank market, disrupt a large share of credit lines, and trigger a deep recession. These results underscore the need for prompt policy intervention to prevent cascading effects and costly bailouts.
abstract_zh: 我们通过构建并估计一个异质性主体宏观经济模型，探讨了美国经济中资本流动的动态特性。在该模型中，信贷、存款及银行间关系在有限信息条件下，通过最优分散化选择内生演化。研究结果表明，严重的金融危机源于金融部门高度集中化的内生形成。在此背景下，针对系统性中介机构的自强化银行挤兑，尽管罕见，却能冻结银行间市场，扰乱大量信贷额度，并引发深度衰退。这些结果强调了及时政策干预的必要性，以防止连锁效应及高成本的救助措施。

title: Magnitude effects in preference reversals: A meta-analysis
title_zh: 偏好反转中的量级效应：一项元分析
title_primary: 偏好反转中的量级效应：一项元分析
title_secondary: Magnitude effects in preference reversals: A meta-analysis
authors: Yong Lu
official: 官方在线 2025-09-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Preference reversal (PR) occurs when individuals reverse their preferences between safe and risky bets depending on the elicitation method (e.g., direct choice vs. certainty equivalence). Although prior research has rarely examined the influence of relative payoff ratios between bets on choice preferences and PR, this meta-analysis synthesizes data from 22 experiments or treatments across 13 studies, comprising 326 unique scenarios (N = 1,947). The mean effect sizes were close to zero, but substantial heterogeneity emerged across studies. Several idiosyncratic moderators—including probability and payoff structures and design features—appear to shape when choice preferences and PR are more likely to occur.
abstract_zh: 偏好反转（PR）现象指的是个体在安全赌注与风险赌注之间，依据不同的诱导方法（如直接选择与确定性等价）而逆转其偏好。尽管以往研究鲜少探讨赌注间相对支付比率对选择偏好及PR的影响，本元分析综合了13项研究中22个实验或处理组的数据，涵盖326个独特情境（N = 1,947）。平均效应量接近零，但研究间存在显著异质性。若干特定调节变量——包括概率与支付结构及设计特征——似乎决定了选择偏好与PR更可能发生的条件。

title: Does CEO power influence corporate ESG performance? Evidence from China
title_zh: CEO权力是否影响企业ESG表现？来自中国的证据
title_primary: CEO权力是否影响企业ESG表现？来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Does CEO power influence corporate ESG performance? Evidence from China
authors: Zongze Li Zhengyuan Liu Yuetang Wang Business School, Nanjing University, Nanjing, China
official: 官方在线 2025-08-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Amid the growing push for sustainable development, corporate leaders are increasingly called upon to adopt a long-term perspective to mitigate potential external risks. However, whether centralized leadership power benefits a firm’s long-term growth and enhances its ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) performance remains an open question. Drawing on a sample of Shanghai and Shenzhen-listed companies from 2009 to 2022, this study empirically examines the relationship between CEO power and corporate ESG performance. The findings suggest that CEO power significantly promotes ESG performance. Building on a dual-value (firm and individual) and reputational framework, the mechanism analysis indicates that formal power exerts a regulatory effect and informal power provides a guiding effect. Both of them are crucial in explaining how CEO power, by driving digital transformation and stabilizing operations, enhances ESG outcomes. Further analysis indicates that CEO power exerts the strongest influence on the social dimension of ESG, followed by governance and then environment. These core findings also exhibit heterogeneity across different industries. Enhanced information transparency is found to be an effective way for firms to leverage their internal drivers, whereas higher levels of internal control and external audit constraints may conflict with CEO power, thereby weakening its positive impact on ESG performance.
abstract_zh: 在可持续发展日益受到重视的背景下，企业领导者被寄予厚望，需采取长远视角以规避潜在外部风险。然而，集权式领导力是否有利于企业长期成长并提升其ESG（环境、社会与治理）表现，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。本研究以2009年至2022年沪深上市公司为样本，实证考察了CEO权力与企业ESG表现之间的关系。研究发现，CEO权力显著促进了企业ESG表现。基于双重价值（企业层面与个体层面）及声誉框架的机制分析表明，正式权力发挥调节作用，非正式权力则提供引导作用，两者在解释CEO权力如何通过推动数字化转型和稳定运营来提升ESG成效方面均至关重要。进一步分析显示，CEO权力对ESG中社会维度的促进作用最为显著，其次为治理维度，最后为环境维度。这些核心发现在不同行业间亦表现出异质性。研究还发现，增强信息透明度是企业有效利用内部驱动力的途径，而较高的内部控制水平和外部审计约束则可能与CEO权力产生冲突，从而削弱其对ESG表现的积极影响。
